CMOS beta-multiplier reference with startup
.include "circuit.spice"
.include "models.spice"
VDD vdd 0 PWL(0 0 1u 3.3 5u 3.3 6u 2.8 10u 2.8)
XDUT vdd 0 na su out astra_042_cmos_beta_multiplier_reference
.temp 27
.options method=gear reltol=1e-5
* @spec i33 range 0.000006 0.000015 unit=A
* @spec i28 range 0.000006 0.000015 unit=A
* @spec bias33 range 0.65 1.1 unit=V
* @spec start_off range 0 0.5 unit=V
* @spec steady33 range 0 0.000001 unit=A
.control
set filetype=ascii
tran 1n 10u
let io=(v(vdd)-v(out))/100k
meas tran i33 AVG io FROM=3u TO=4u
meas tran i28 AVG io FROM=8u TO=9u
meas tran bias33 AVG v(na) FROM=3u TO=4u
meas tran start_off AVG v(su) FROM=3u TO=4u
meas tran steady33 PP io FROM=3u TO=4u
write out.raw
quit
.endc
.end
